name: claude-mem
tagline_zh: 你的AI每次对话都失忆？它把每次会话自动压缩成记忆，下次开场直接续上，连三周前的细节都记得。
tagline_en: Your AI forgets every chat? It auto-compresses each session into memory, so next time it picks up right where you.
desc_en: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant
why_zh: 同类只存摘要，它用AI按场景压缩并主动注入相关记忆，让上下文像连续剧一样自然衔接。
why_en: Others store summaries; it compresses by context and injects relevant memories proactively, making continuity feel like a TV.
